An EL or ECL place it holds domestically is lost to its association (Art. 3.03). In 2023/24 (Sevilla, labelled EL in the Wikipedia team list): Sevilla took a CL group place. The holder is guaranteed an EL group place (EL Art. 3.09). If it qualifies for the EL through its league, the vacancy is filled by the cup winner of association 7 and the main path is rebalanced (Art. 3.10 a). If it qualifies for the CL through its league it chooses CL or EL (Art. 3.11). In 2023/24 (West Ham United, labelled ECL in the Wikipedia team list, no European place through the league): West Ham took the EL group place. No vacancy arose, so no EL cup winner moved up for this reason (EL default list has 11 direct group places and the ECL holder as the twelfth). Second source: agree.
